Real row 4 S3cb + RE + RE2 = code 3582aed, stage B from v7's A: --backend game --row 4 --core l2 --d1 --g8-holdout --session-keyframes --render-evidence --band-evidence --dataset real --resume --sessions ab. Started right after RE's B eval, not chosen by RE's score (supervisor 21:20: the form rests on KinectFusion Eq. 9 + the GT-free diagnosis).

KinectFusion (Newcombe et al., ISMAR 2011, sec. 3.3; original checked) Eq. 9: 'Psi(eta) = min(1, eta/mu) sgn(eta) iff eta >= -mu, null otherwise' -- a reading writes 'inside' (negative SDF) up to mu behind the measured surface and nothing beyond; online, per frame. In the layer's element rule (hit resets, -ln p_miss per 'not a surface' observation, retire above ln 99) a reading within mu in front of the element (delta in [-mu, -(tol + extent))) is one such observation; beyond mu no evidence.
mu = the layer's truncation 0.15 m (LayerConfig.truncation, the TSDF runs' active-window truncation), tol + extent as the element rule's on band; no new constant.

GT-free diagnosis on the S3cb B map (analysis/behind_hidden_s3cb.json): of the first-echo Gaussians of A-view pixels 5-15 cm behind a B reading, 56.8 % had a hit (median 2) and 59.6 % had most blocked readings beyond the band, so the fork's session hidden vote ends 14.3 %. Offline replay of the band evidence on the S3cb B map: analysis/band_replay_s3cb.json (running).

As in TSDF fusion, a real surface lying within mu behind another measured surface along the readings (e.g. a wall within 15 cm behind a thin object seen only from the front in B) is ended too: the same behaviour as the TSDF's truncation band.
